recipes.title: Lemon garlic roast chicken
recipes.ingredients:
1 whole chicken (about 1.6 kg)
2 lemons
6 cloves garlic
3 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
4 sprigs thyme
recipes.steps:
Heat the oven to 220°C.
Pat the chicken dry and rub it with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Halve the lemons and put them in the cavity with the garlic and thyme.
Roast for 60 to 70 minutes, until the juices run clear.
Rest for 10 minutes before carving.

recipes.title: Weeknight tomato soup
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp butter
1 onion, chopped
2 cloves garlic
800 g canned whole tomatoes
500 ml vegetable stock
1/2 cup cream
1 tsp sugar
Salt to taste
recipes.steps:
Melt the butter and soften the onion for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, stock and sugar; simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and season.

recipes.title: Banana oat pancakes
recipes.ingredients:
2 ripe bananas
2 eggs
1 cup rolled oats
1/2 tsp baking powder
1 pinch salt
1 tbsp butter for the pan
recipes.steps:
Blend the bananas, eggs, oats, baking powder and salt until smooth.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes.
Cook small pancakes in butter over medium heat, 2 minutes a side.

recipes.title: Chickpea and spinach curry
recipes.ingredients:
Base:
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
1 tbsp grated ginger
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp curry paste
Curry:
800 g chickpeas, drained
400 ml coconut milk
200 g spinach
1 lime
recipes.steps:
Fry the onion in the oil until golden, about 10 minutes.
Add the ginger, garlic and curry paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts, then finish with lime juice.

recipes.title: Classic chocolate chip cookies
recipes.ingredients:
225 g butter, softened
200 g brown sugar
100 g white sugar
2 eggs
1 tsp vanilla
340 g flour
1 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp salt
300 g chocolate chips
recipes.steps:
Heat the oven to 180°C.
Cream the butter and sugars, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, baking soda and salt, then the chocolate chips.
Scoop onto lined trays and bake for 10 to 12 minutes.
